findings: On the five-family development matrix, preregistered three-arm one-stage-then-commit used 6655 vs 8600 candidate compilations (22.62% less) than fully searching natural+RCM, matched quality on four families and improved one; cubic18_s880319 reached 105 live nodes from seeded-diverse vs natural 107 / RCM 111.
A two-arm early-commit controller was cheaper but selected the wrong conventional start on cubic18_s880319, demonstrating early-commit brittleness.
Rebuild V1 had zero mismatches over 1083 effective updates. periodic_32 reduced max allocated/live and max current allocations in 12/12 cells, with 30 rebuilds; absolute ratio>=4 was over-triggered.
Rank-polynomial semiring evaluation exactly matched exhaustive/ROBDD Hamming-weight counts on all four preregistered smooth deterministic decomposable circuit cells.
BDD2Seq and LEO independently support diverse/learned variable-order starts and explicit accounting of search/prediction overhead, but in different BDD application domains.
